{{Top|leg}}
'''Plastiskin''' could be applied to the skin of an individual to conceal items. Uncle [[Gargon (uncle)|Gargon]] used plastiskin on his left hand to conceal a remote control that connected to the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] secreted around his mansion.
